data.raw_text:
This morning, I started my daily 10,000 steps. I have been counting them since 2015.

Some days in Manila traffic. Other days between the rows at our  Agnep Heritage Farm in Benguet. Last week I was testing a new soap recipe for Aninag. There is a column on AI governance sitting on my desk.

It is Mother’s Day. I am thinking about all of it.

The girls are grown, but the mothering did not stop. It went into the farm and the soap and the writing and the steps.

For a long time, I thought “Mother” was the title that held everything. It still holds a lot. It is not the only one.

Happy Mother’s Day to all of us.

#Mothers #MothersDayCelebration #DignityInAging
